propositions: tolerant_parse returns the first parseable JSON object in a model reply, causing quoted tool results or examples to be extracted instead of the actual payload
The defect recurs across model swaps and provider changes, indicating a systemic issue in the prompted extraction path rather than a model-specific bug
Native structured output via provider APIs (Bedrock outputConfig) is unsafe to enable unconditionally without per-model measurement of compatibility
Prompted structured replies require an explicit sentinel output channel co-shipped with the directive to ensure atomic extraction and reduce ambiguity
A deterministic raw-reply artifact capability enables reproducible debugging and measurement of schema-valid decoy collisions across provider matrices
